utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So, Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case number IT-99-36-T, the Prosecutor versus Radoslav Brdjanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, madam. Mr. Brdjanin, can you follow the proceedings in a language that you can understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning. Yes, I can follow in a language I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, and good morning to you. Appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Nicholas Koumjian and Denise Gustin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, and good morning to you. Appearances for Radoslav Brdjanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. CUNNINGHAM
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. David Cunningham with Aleksandar Vujic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, and good morning to you too. Any preliminaries? Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: I would just advise Your Honours, I did not interview, but I spoke briefly to the witness yesterday.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: You are withdrawing him?

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: No. I don't know if we need to go into private session for this.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Let's go into private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: -- Or give any indications as to who he could be. Yes, Mr. Koumjian.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, I want to bring to the attention of the Trial Chamber what I feel are inappropriate gestures by the accused, Mr. Brdjanin, when the witness is testifying. I see him several times making a gesture with his hands similar to what I've just done, which would indicate to me that he is indicating some objection to what the witness is testifying to, which I think is -- well, any gesture is inappropriate in this context.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. Cunningham, to be truthful, I was not watching your client, so I cannot confirm or pass any judgement on what Mr. Koumjian has just stated. However, there were previous occasions when I did notice some Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts. kind of reaction, similar reactions, from your client on other days, so I wouldn't be surprised at all if this is precisely what is happening. In the past I have always asked Mr. Ackerman to address himself straight to the witness -- to the client, and I will leave it entirely in your hands. I mean, you know how to do it, because you are a trained lawyer with a lot of experience behind you, so I'm not interfering with that.

utterances.speaker: MR. CUNNINGHAM
utterances.text: No. I understand that, Your Honour, and I'd like just a minute, if the Court pleases, to do that right now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you. Mr. Vujic, you need to help him, I think.

utterances.speaker: MR. CUNNINGHAM
utterances.text: Your Honour, I'm in the same position as you. I didn't see any gestures, but what I am told is that he was not trying to make any gestures towards the witness but rather trying to make gestures towards Mr. Vujic. But I've counselled with the accused to --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: It's okay. I'll take your word and your client's word. Mr. Cunningham, I take it that your client will be more careful in trying to attract the attention of Mr. Vujic.

utterances.speaker: MR. CUNNINGHAM
utterances.text: Judge, I've advised him, and I'm not giving away anything with respect to attorney-client privilege, but I've advised him to avoid any gesture that might be interpreted as inappropriate towards the witness or this Court.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Actually, in this courtroom there is one advantage which you don't find in other courtrooms and that is the proximity of the accused to counsel, which is ideal, right? In other words, Mr. Brdjanin, I'm sure, can call Mr. Vujic, and Mr. Vujic will pay attention or give him attention. But otherwise, any gestures which are uncalled for, please try to avoid, because we can review the video recording and it would involve us in a waste of time, unnecessary waste of time, and possibly undesirable measures that will need to be taken if this is the case. So let's bring the witness in, and I am going to explain -- closed session. Let's go into closed session first.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I wish to once more thank, in open session, the members, the staff members of the interpretation unit and the technical staff, and everyone else who is present in this courtroom. Once more, you have given a very valid contribution to enable a witness to return home earlier than expected and to save this Tribunal valuable resources. And this, by overstaying beyond your contractual time. I wish that this is communicated, both to the head of the unit, respective units, as well as to the President of this Tribunal. I thank you. We stand adjourned until tomorrow morning at 9.00. The idea is now to try to make -- do your best, both of you, to have the next witness finished by Friday, because the next witness was scheduled to go on -- continue on Monday. So if we can send him back home on Friday or Saturday, that would be also a very valid, positive step. Okay?

utterances.speaker: MR. KOUMJIAN
utterances.text: I don't want to take up your time, but I understand that would not help much because we don't have a witness for Monday. But we'll deal with that tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Get the witness or Monday or get something else for Monday. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 24th day of July 2003, at 9.00 a.m. 17 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 12.39 p.m.
